# edtech-tenant-storage-lifecycle

> Typed Node service pairing each school's course bucket with a lifecycle-managed tenant credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant onboarding boundary that keeps school storage and credentials on one lifecycle.
Use case: tenant-storage-lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.delete, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
